description: This file contains implementation details for the torch profiler orchestration, including configuration classes, base profiler class, and related utility functions.

classes.name: ExperimentalConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for experimental profiler features.

classes.name: ProfilerConfig
classes.description: Main configuration class for the profiler, including state and various profiling options.

classes.name: ProfilerStateBase
classes.description: Base class representing the state of a profiler instance, including callback management and configuration.

methods.name: ExperimentalConfig::operator bool
methods.description: Converts the experimental config to a boolean indicating if metrics are set.

methods.name: ProfilerConfig::disabled
methods.description: Checks if the profiler is disabled based on its state.

methods.name: ProfilerConfig::global
methods.description: Checks if the profiler is in a global (Kineto on-demand) state.

methods.name: ProfilerConfig::pushGlobalCallbacks
methods.description: Determines if global callbacks should be pushed based on state and config.

methods.name: ProfilerConfig::toIValue
methods.description: Serializes the profiler config to an IValue list.

methods.name: ProfilerConfig::fromIValue
methods.description: Deserializes a ProfilerConfig from an IValue list.

methods.name: ProfilerStateBase::ProfilerStateBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing the profiler state with a given config.

methods.name: ProfilerStateBase::~ProfilerStateBase
methods.description: Destructor that checks for leaked callback handles.

methods.name: ProfilerStateBase::get
methods.description: Retrieves the current profiler state, either global or thread-local.

methods.name: ProfilerStateBase::push
methods.description: Pushes a new profiler state onto the appropriate stack.

methods.name: ProfilerStateBase::pop
methods.description: Pops the current profiler state from the appropriate stack.

methods.name: ProfilerStateBase::setCallbackHandle
methods.description: Sets a callback handle, removing any existing one.

methods.name: ProfilerStateBase::removeCallback
methods.description: Removes the callback handle if set.

methods.name: profilerEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the profiler is enabled.

methods.name: profilerType
methods.description: Returns the type of the active profiler.
